reading.body:
Expedient Pittsburgh South publishes 6 MW of IT capacity across 26,000 square feet of technical space, representing the largest single facility by capacity in Pennsylvania on record.

The facility's certifications point toward regulated enterprise workloads rather than AI training. PCI DSS qualifies it for payment card processing. HIPAA and HITRUST together qualify it for healthcare data and its audit requirements. Large-scale AI training typically does not require these certifications, though inference or data preparation workloads inside regulated environments would fit here.

At 6 MW, this facility is medium-scale for modern compute infrastructure. At 40 kilowatts per rack, a density common in AI training, it could house roughly 150 racks. At 10 kilowatts per rack, typical for colocation, it could house roughly 600. The operator does not publish a per-rack power figure, so neither figure represents an operator claim.

Pennsylvania has 14 mapped facilities in this dataset, but only two publish megawatt capacity. Those two total 11 MW together. Expedient Pittsburgh South accounts for 6 of those 11 MW. This ranking reflects the limits of public disclosure as much as facility size: most Pennsylvania facilities publish no capacity data at all.
